title: neomolina racemosa
intro: Neomolina racemosa, commonly known as the "yellow mountain rose", is a flowering plant species native to Mexico and parts of Central America. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating various health issues such as wounds, fever, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Neomolina racemosa include its ability to reduce inflammation, calm the nervous system, and aid in digestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
